data.name: Variant Channeling - Destruction
data.description: Heal - Creatures gain a +%1 channel bonus on attack and damage rolls against objects, CMB for sunder attempts, and Strength checks to break objects until the end of your next turn. Harm - Unattended objects take full channel damage (not half).|ChannelModifier
